description: Two fixed voltages, each typed or dragged into its display, each with a gate input that can switch it off

inputs.text: With a cable here that voltage reaches its output only while this is high, and that output is 0V otherwise; with nothing patched the voltage is always at the output

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set on that display

notes: a voltage is set by dragging its display, and can be typed in as well
